title: Automate changelog and onboard Icaria-20B v1.0 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Onboard Icaria-20B v1.0 with curated metadata and performance profiles; add changelog/release-notes automation that aggregates perf test results and metadata diffs to generate model registry release notes.
description: Motivation: Add Icaria-20B v1.0 to the model-registry with validated performance profiles and automate changelog/release-note generation so onboarding is repeatable and traceable. This PR does two things in one change: 1) Onboard 'icaria-20b-v1.0' with model metadata, compatibility tags, and calibrated perf profiles (latency/throughput/cost estimates) generated from the perf-lab runs; 2) Introduce changelog automation that composes release notes from (a) model metadata diffs, (b) perf-profile deltas and summary statistics, and (c) human-provided 'notes' field. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata JSON and perf-profile YAML - [x] Wire model to registry index and cache invalidation - [x] Add changelog generator helper and GitHub Action to publish draft release notes to PR - [x] Add unit tests for changelog generator and small integration test using sample perf output - [x] Update docs reference for onboarding process Implementation notes: The perf profiles include 8 sequence-length buckets and per-hardware estimates for g4dn, p4d, and dedicated-pool profiles. Metadata includes model architecture, tokenizer family, max_seq, recommended quantization, and compatibility tags (e.g. 'causal', 'kv-cache-compatible'). The changelog automation is a small Go binary (cmd/changelog-gen) plus a GitHub workflow (.github/workflows/model-changelog.yml) that runs when files under 'models/' change; it computes a structured summary and posts a markdown draft to the PR. Security: no secrets added to repo; action uses existing read-only perf-artifacts IAM role. Backwards compatibility: changelog generator is opt-in (requires 'changelog: auto' in model metadata) so existing models are unaffected. Testing: perf-lab runs were used to produce the attached perf-summary JSON; unit tests exercise the metadata diff algorithm; CI originally showed a flaky integration test (db-migration-mock) that failed once and was re-run. See CI details below. Related work: ENG-4821 tracks onboarding cadence and perf thresholds; PM-229 requests better release notes for model changes.
